summary: The email provider's default identifier normalizer now throws 'Invalid email address format.' for an address containing a double quote, not exactly one '@', an empty local or domain part, or a domain without a dot; before it only lower-cased, trimmed and split on '@'
The optional nodemailer peer dependency range moves from ^6.6.5 to ^7.0.7, so the email provider now expects nodemailer 7 instead of 6
GET /api/auth/session and /api/auth/csrf responses now carry Cache-Control: private, no-cache, no-store with Pragma: no-cache and Expires: 0; before they sent only Content-Type
The optional @auth/core peer dependency pin moves from 0.34.2 to 0.34.3
The GitHub provider now sets issuer to https://github.com/login/oauth by default (it was unset), so openid-client's unconditional iss check on the callback passes without configuring it
getToken() returns null when the Authorization header's Bearer value is malformed percent-encoding instead of throwing from decodeURIComponent

OAuth state, nonce and PKCE check cookies now record the provider that minted them and the callback throws when a different provider handles it; before any provider's callback accepted them (sign-ins in flight across the upgrade fail once)

The email provider's default identifier normalizer applies Unicode NFKC normalization before validating the address, so homoglyphs of '@' are collapsed and rejected; before validation ran on the raw string
An explicitly configured NEXTAUTH_URL now takes precedence over the auto-detected forwarded host when VERCEL or AUTH_TRUST_HOST is set; before the forwarded host won in trusted-host mode
